**Why I stopped instead of writing the YAML anyway**
- **The rules have to come from the data.** The staging models copy the raw tables unchanged, so the rules behind each metric are only visible in the data. I need queries to see things like the possible statuses on subscriptions, invoices and payments, what the opportunity stages are called, whether internal or deleted accounts and child accounts should be excluded, and whether refunds show up as credit notes or as payment statuses. Guessing these would give finance numbers that look right but are wrong.
- **Nothing could be checked.** You defined done as ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs passing. I can't run either one, or build a helper model.

**What I learned from reading the SQL**
- **MRR, ARR, paying customers, ARPA, new customers and churn:** `fct_subscription_months` has one row per subscription per month-end (Jan 2023 to Jun 2025). It carries status, plan, billing interval, seats, unit price, discount and currency. Prices are in minor units, so they must be divided by the currency's minor-unit exponent and converted with `usd_per_unit`. Annual plans need to be divided down to a monthly amount.
- **Billings:** `fct_invoices`, typed as subscription or services.
- **Recognized revenue:** `fct_revenue_recognition`. It spreads subscription invoices daily over their service period, and books services invoices on the day they're issued. It doesn't filter by invoice status.
- **Cash collected:** `fct_payments`.
- **Refunds:** `fct_credit_notes`, which has a reason column.
- **Billable usage:** `fct_usage_daily`, split by event type.
- **Bookings, new bookings and win rate:** `fct_opportunities`, split by type and stage, with amounts already in USD.
- **Dimensions:** `dim_accounts` (region, segment, country, billing currency, internal and deleted flags), `dim_plans` (plan family, billing interval), `dim_sales_reps` (team, region) and `dim_date` (fiscal year, quarter and month).

Then I'll profile the data, write the semantic models, metrics and any helper models in relay_dbt/models/semantic/, and iterate until ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs both pass. If you'd rather have a draft built only from reading the SQL, I can write one now. It would contain guessed filter values and wouldn't have been through either check.

summary: Built Relay's dbt semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/: 8 SQL helper views (sem_*; denormalized, USD-converted, internal Relay QA/Demo and deleted accounts excluded) plus 4 MetricFlow YAML files defining 8 semantic models and 27 metrics. Coverage: mrr/arr (active+past_due seats x price less discount, annual/12, trials/canceled excluded), paying_customers, arpa, new_customers, churned_customers, logo_churn_rate (churned/prior-month paying), billings (pre-tax, ex draft/void, gross of refunds), recognized_revenue (spread over service periods), cash_collected (succeeded only; failed tracked separately), refunds (all 4 credit reasons), billable_usage (api_call only; constant 288/day health_check heartbeat excluded), bookings/new_bookings/expansion_bookings, win_rate (count and amount), open_pipeline. Sliceable by segment, region, country, currency, plan family/interval, invoice type/status, payment method, credit reason, sales team/rep, and month. Every model, dimension, measure, and metric carries a description stating includes/excludes. Verified: ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs pass with 0 errors/warnings; mf queries tie out (Jun-25 MRR $4.18M/1,192 customers, billings = recognized $81.9M, cash $86.2M, bookings $61.0M).

Built the Relay MetricFlow semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/. Both ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs pass with zero errors/warnings; all metrics were spot-checked with ./mf query against reference SQL (monthly MRR, paying customers, JPY conversion, bookings by team and net new MRR reconcile exactly).

Files: two helper SQL models (customer_months: account x month-end grid with new/churned/reactivated/retained flags and new/expansion/contraction/churned/reactivation MRR; usage_daily_classified: daily usage tagged with subscription status in force and is_billable) and six YAML files defining 12 semantic models (accounts, plans, sales_reps, fiscal_calendar, subscription_months, customer_months, invoices, revenue_recognition, payments, credit_notes, usage_daily, opportunities) and 45 metrics: mrr, arr, paying_customers, arpa, paid_seats, active_subscriptions, trialing_subscriptions, new_customers, churned_customers, reactivated_customers, customers_start_of_month, logo_churn_rate, new/expansion/contraction/churned/reactivation_mrr, net_new_mrr, mrr_start_of_month, gross_mrr_churn_rate, billings, billings_incl_tax, invoice_tax, invoices_issued, uncollectible_billings, open_receivables, recognized_revenue, cash_collected, payments_received, failed_payments, refunds, credit_notes_issued, net_cash_collected, billable_usage, api_calls, active_usage_accounts, bookings, new_bookings, expansion_bookings, won/lost/closed_opportunities, win_rate, average_deal_size, open_pipeline. Every semantic model, entity, dimension, measure and metric has a description stating inclusions and exclusions. Dimensions available: segment, region, country, billing currency, internal/deleted flags, parent account, plan name/family/billing interval, sales team, rep name/region, subscription status, invoice type/status, payment status/method, credit reason, event type, opportunity type/stage, fiscal year/quarter/month via a calendar_date entity.

Business rules derived from the data: exclude internal (Relay QA) accounts everywhere (they carry subscriptions, invoices, credits and ~23% of API calls); keep deleted accounts; MRR/customers use only active and past_due subscription versions at month end (canceled versions are open-ended, trials never count); annual prices /12, discount applied, minor units converted with currency exponent (JPY = 0) at month-end FX; snapshot metrics are non-additive (period-end value). Billings exclude draft and void invoices and tax; recognized revenue also excludes uncollectible invoices (exposed separately as bad debt); cash collected = succeeded payments only; refunds = credit notes (all issued after a paid invoice); billable usage = api_call on paid-subscription days (health_check is a fixed 288/day heartbeat); opportunity amount_usd is ACV so bookings are ACV; win rate = won / (won + lost) by count, excluding open deals.

Known limitation (documented): snapshot metrics grouped by fiscal-calendar dimensions without metric_time return only the latest month end; flow metrics slice by fiscal periods correctly.

Built the dbt/MetricFlow semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/, deriving business logic from the warehouse data.

Added 3 helper SQL models:
- int_subscription_economics.sql: subscription×month MRR (seats×price×(1-discount), USD-converted, annualized plans normalized to monthly), excludes internal accounts.
- int_account_months.sql: full account×month spine used to derive paying/new-logo/churned-logo flags via month-over-month comparison.
- int_billing_invoices.sql: invoices enriched with the plan effective at billing time and net-of-discount billed amount in USD, excludes internal accounts.

Added 9 semantic model YAML files defining 18 metrics, each with explicit inclusion/exclusion descriptions:
- sem_dimensions.yml: sem_accounts, sem_plans, sem_sales_reps (segment, region, country, currency, plan family/interval, sales team dimensions; no measures).
- sem_subscription_economics.yml: mrr, arr (active+past_due subscriptions only; excludes trialing/canceled/internal accounts).
- sem_customers.yml: customers, customers_at_period_start, new_customers, logo_churn, churn_rate, arpa.
- sem_billing_invoices.yml: billings (net of discount, pre-tax, excludes draft/void invoices).
- sem_revenue_recognition.yml: recognized_revenue (ratable/accrual basis, excludes draft/void, includes uncollectible).
- sem_payments.yml: cash_collected (succeeded payments only).
- sem_credit_notes.yml: refunds (all credit note reasons).
- sem_usage.yml: billable_usage (api_call events only, excludes constant health_check heartbeat).
- sem_opportunities.yml: bookings, new_bookings, closed_won_deals, closed_deals, win_rate.

Both `./dbt parse` and `./mf validate-configs` pass with zero errors/warnings. Spot-checked most metrics with `./mf query`, including cross-model dimension joins (MRR by plan family and segment, bookings by sales team), confirming correct values and joins.

Built the Relay dbt semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/. ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs both pass. validate-configs shows one warning: a second daily time spine (sem_fiscal_time_spine) was added to carry the fiscal calendar because the existing spine is outside the folder. Queries currently use it correctly; if it ever becomes an error, move the fiscal columns into metricflow_time_spine.

Rules found in the data and applied everywhere:
- Internal accounts and soft-deleted (never-invoiced) accounts are excluded.
- A customer is the top-level parent account; subsidiaries roll up.
- Amounts are converted from each currency's smallest unit (JPY has no decimals) to USD. MRR uses the month-end rate.
- The fiscal year starts 1 Feb (FY2025 = Feb 2024-Jan 2025), available as metric_time__fiscal_quarter and metric_time__fiscal_year.
- Billings drop draft and void invoices.
- Credit notes (all against paid invoices) are refunds.
- Billable usage is api_call only; health_check pings are excluded.
- Opportunity amounts are annual contract value.

Metrics:
- Recurring revenue: MRR (active and past-due subscriptions, net of discount, annual plans divided by 12, month-end snapshot), ARR, paying customers, ARPA, paid seats, paying and trialing subscriptions.
- Customers and churn: new and reactivated customers, churned customers, customers at start of month, logo churn rate, and MRR movements (new, reactivation, expansion, contraction, churned) that sum to net new MRR.
- Billing and cash: billings (after discount, before tax), gross billings, discounts, tax, total invoiced, invoice count, recognized revenue (ratable by day for subscriptions, at issue for services), cash collected, failed payments, refunds, net cash collected, billable usage, accounts with usage.
- Sales: bookings, new and expansion bookings, open pipeline, deals won and closed, win rate, new-business win rate.

Dimensions: account and customer segment, region, country, currency and flags; plan name, family and interval; sales rep, team and region; and subscription, invoice, payment, refund and opportunity attributes. Every semantic model, dimension, measure and metric has a description of what it includes and excludes.

Checked with real queries: the MRR movements tie exactly to the change in MRR, segment splits add up to the totals, and quarter or fiscal-year MRR equals the last month's MRR.
